statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential etiology of the patient's transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
CPT code 93271 (prolonged cardiac event monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is necessary to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances that may not be evident on standard electrocardiography
The diagnosis code G45.9 (transient cerebral ischemic attack, unspecified) is documented
